title: BioVAT read_qc pipeline parameters
description: Raw read quality checks with FastQC

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data.

samplesheet.description: BioVAT samplesheet (CSV) with one row per read group. Columns: sample, library_id, flowcell_id, lane, platform, fastq_1, fastq_2, bam, single_end. Rows with a bam instead of fastq files are skipped.

reads.description: Alternative to the samplesheet: a YAML or JSON file with one entry per read group, with a meta map (id, read_group) and reads (a list of fastq files), or the reads from a calling pipeline.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
